data.title: Avigdor Liberman: Benjamin Netanyahu must face treason probe over reported Iran plot | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Calling on Attorney-General Gali Baharv-Miara to open a criminal probe, Liberman accused Netanyahu of attempting to draw Israel into a military confrontation to delay the elections.
data.keywords: Avigdor Liberman,Benjamin Netanyahu,IDF,Iran,Politics,Israel Iran War,Attorney-General,Yisrael Beytenu,Gali Baharav-Miara,criminality,2026 Israeli Elections
